items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: That's what everybody wonders today, you know, why didn't he take myself? And -- like with Dicky Wells, the older guys out of the band.

ctx.x: I don't know. I don't know. That's what everybody wonders today, you know, why didn't he take myself? And -- like with Dicky Wells, the older guys out of the band. That's Basie's -- and Serge Chaloff and Buddy DeFranco. I couldn't see why he took any of them because Basie had enough soloists in his band to keep the thing going to me, you know.
Somebody must have sold him a bill of goods, you know. (Inaudible).

items.title: Harry Edison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Sidney Catlett, Marlow Morris, piano player, Red Callender and John Simmons, both of them [on bass]. And Dickey Wells…
